name: Antigravity — Cloud Strategist (Strategy-Only Seat)
description: Antigravity IDE as a cross-platform Hivemind Council peer and Cloud Strategist. Strategy-only seat: reviews and recommends, never implements and never commits. Connects to the Omega Hub MCP on port 8016.

extensions.description: Non-normative Omega Engine provenance extension. Declares that the card describes a seat of the Omega sovereign fleet and that the card's x-omega block is Omega-specific and not part of the A2A specification.

skills.name: Strategy-Only Architectural Review
skills.description: Review and recommend on strategy and architecture from outside the engine's own loop. Explicitly does not write source code and does not make git commits; OpenCode is the commit authority.

skills.description: Coordinate across the Hivemind Council as a non-OpenCode peer, declaring presence, reading fleet awareness and handing off work to OpenCode agents.

mtlsSecurityScheme.description: APPROXIMATION - NOT AN mTLS CLAIM. Omega seat identity is enforced at the Tailscale/WireGuard MESH layer (tailnet-only, ACL-gated; tailnet IPv4 <TAILNET_IP> and IPv6 <TAILNET_IPV6>; enforced by tailscaled Serve routes and recorded in config/lan_exposure_allowlist.yaml). It is NOT HTTP-layer mutual TLS and NOT an API key. The A2A SecurityScheme oneof (§4.5.1) has no member that expresses mesh-layer network identity, so mtlsSecurityScheme (§4.5.6) is used as the nearest available marker. Per §4.5.6 that member carries only an optional `description`, which is why it cannot encode mesh specifics - hence this field. A client MUST NOT read this scheme as evidence of negotiated mTLS on the transport.

x-omega.statement: NON-NORMATIVE. No field in this block is defined by the A2A v1.0 specification. The card as a whole is a descriptive manifest, not a claim of protocol conformance.
conformity_gaps: No A2A method set is implemented: message/send, message/stream, tasks/get, tasks/list, tasks/cancel, tasks/subscribe, tasks/pushNotificationConfig/* and authenticatedExtendedCard are all absent (A2A v1.0 §3.1.1-§3.1.11).
Nothing serves the registered well-known discovery URI /.well-known/agent-card.json (§8.2, §14.3). Probed: 8016 and 8019 both return HTTP 404 for that path.
No Task, Message, Part or Artifact objects exist in the runtime, so the §4.1 core data model is unimplemented.

No JWS signing is performed. The `signatures` field (§4.4.7) is absent because Omega has no signing key and no RFC 8785 canonicalizer; emitting a placeholder signature would be forgery. See §8.4 for what is required.
capabilities.streaming / pushNotifications / extendedAgentCard are all false (§4.4.3) because none of those behaviours exists in an A2A sense.
No protocol version negotiation (§3.6, §8.3.2) and no A2A-Version header (§14.2.1) is emitted.
No tenant routing (§4.4.6) is implemented, so `tenant` is omitted.

seat.slot_authority: This seat has NO entry in config/wads/_omega_default/entities.yaml at all. No slot is recorded anywhere. Reported as `unassigned`.

hub.probe: GET /sse -> HTTP 200 (SSE stream held open); GET / -> HTTP 404; GET /.well-known/agent-card.json -> HTTP 404

exchange.probe: GET / -> HTTP 200 (service: omega-exchange/2.0); GET /.well-known/agent-card.json -> HTTP 404 (body: "No artifact at '.well-known/agent-card.json'")
